_readme: Your VoiceBot phone receptionist. Delete this file if you only use the chatbot.
id: same rules as bot_id; usually the same value. Fixed at onboarding.
vapi_assistant_id: Easy Cloud fills this in after creating your assistant. phone_number: your inbound line in E.164 (+1...).
services: spoken name → { eventTypeId (your Cal.com event type), price (what the agent may quote), minutes }. The agent quotes ONLY these prices.
settings: only hours, address, parking_note, type, city. They go into the agent's prompt word for word.
owner_email / owner_phone: where bookings and messages are sent. Not secret — your Cal.com key is NOT in this file; Easy Cloud holds it.
Changing name, timezone, services or settings needs Easy Cloud to re-push the phone assistant; CI prints a reminder when that applies.
name: Acme Plumbing

settings.hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm; emergency service after hours
